parameters.query: SELECT mdq.id AS queue_id, mdq.message_id, mdq.attempts, mdq.last_error, mdq.scheduled_at, m.content, m.metadata FROM message_delivery_queue mdq JOIN messages m ON m.id = mdq.message_id WHERE mdq.status = 'PENDING' AND mdq.scheduled_at <= now() ORDER BY mdq.scheduled_at ASC LIMIT 50;

-- Resolve delivery target (example: metadata->>'target_chat_id')
SELECT (m.metadata->>'target_chat_id') AS target_chat_id FROM messages m WHERE m.id = '{{ $json["message_id"] }}';

-- On success: mark queue SENT and set sent_at
UPDATE message_delivery_queue SET status = 'SENT', attempts = attempts + 1, sent_at = now() WHERE id = '{{ $json["queue_id"] }}';

INSERT INTO audit_events (user_id, event_type, event_data) VALUES (NULL, 'message_delivery_attempt', jsonb_build_object('queue_id','{{ $json["queue_id"] }}','message_id','{{ $json["message_id"] }}','status', (CASE WHEN (SELECT status FROM message_delivery_queue WHERE id = '{{ $json["queue_id"] }}') = 'SENT' THEN 'SENT' ELSE (CASE WHEN (SELECT status FROM message_delivery_queue WHERE id = '{{ $json["queue_id"] }}') = 'FAILED' THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'RETRY' END) END) ));
